title: "Always shown" visibility mode does not work consistently with "Automatic Load" applets
line: Setting Media Player (or another automatically loaded tray applet) to "Always shown" now keeps its icon in the tray even when nothing is playing.
explanation: Tray applets with X-Plasma-DBusActivationService (Media Player, Battery and Brightness, Kup) are only loaded by the system tray's PlasmoidRegistry while a matching D-Bus service exists, and unloaded when it goes away. The "Always shown" setting only affects how an already loaded item is placed, so with no player running there was no applet to show. The registry now also loads such applets when they are in shownItems, keeps them loaded when their service stops, and loads or unloads them right away when the setting changes.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: load "Always shown" D-Bus activated applets

Applets like Media Player were only loaded while their D-Bus service was
running, so setting them to "Always shown" did nothing until a player
appeared. Now such applets are also loaded whenever they're always shown.

BUG: 444710

media.caption: Pure master, Media Player set to "Always show" in System Tray Settings, plasmashell restarted, no player running: no Media Player icon in the tray
Same setup with the fix: the Media Player icon is in the tray
Pure master: the expanded tray doesn't list Media Player either
With the fix: clicking the tray icon opens Media Player with "No media playing"
